post.summary: Creates a new account, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie.

400.description: Validation failed or email already taken.

post.summary: Validates credentials, returns an access token and sets the refresh cookie.

Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token. The refresh token is rotated:
the old one stops working and a new cookie is set.

401.description: No valid refresh cookie. The user must log in again.

post.summary: Ends the login: revokes the refresh token and deletes the cookie. Always succeeds.

get.summary: The caller's own cards. Other players' hands and the draw pile are secret.

parameters.name: playerId
parameters.description: Optional; if given it must be the caller's own player id.

200.description: The caller's cards (none for a host who only watches).

403.description: Another player's cards were asked for.

post.summary: Trades exactly three cards for escalating reinforcement troops.

Shows what trading the cards would give, without trading them. Works in any phase and for any
number of cards: anything but a valid set of three gives `isValid: false`.

403.description: A card is not in the caller's hand.

get.summary: Lists games, optionally filtered by state.

post.summary: Creates a new game with default settings. The caller becomes host.

get.summary: Returns full details for a game including settings and player list.

put.summary: Starts the game (Lobby → InProgress). Only the host may do this.

409.description: Game is not in Lobby state.

put.summary: Ends the game (InProgress → Finished). Only the host may do this.

409.description: Game is not in InProgress state.

put.summary: Ends the current phase and advances to the next phase or player turn.

403.description: Caller is not part of the game.

put.summary: Moves troops along a connected path during Fortify and ends the turn.

200.description: Troops moved and the next player's Deployment phase started.

409.description: Fortification is not allowed in the current game state.

get.summary: Returns the settings for a game.

put.summary: Updates game settings. Only allowed for the host while in Lobby state.

get.summary: Returns the whole board. Never changes at runtime, so clients may cache it.

Returns the caller's own mission card(s) in the game. Missions are secret,
so other players' cards are never returned.

403.description: Caller is not part of the game.

put.summary: Marks a mission as completed — the assigned player wins.

403.description: Caller is not part of the game.

409.description: Mission not assigned or already completed.

get.summary: Lists all players in a game.

post.summary: Joins the game as the authenticated user. Only allowed in Lobby state.

409.description: Game has started, is full, or the caller is already in it.

get.summary: Returns a single player by ID.

delete.summary: Removes the player from the game. Only allowed in Lobby state and by the player themselves.

put.summary: Administrative fallback for eliminating a player who owns no territories. Only the game host may call it.

403.description: Caller is not the game host.

get.summary: The card trade rules: set values in both trade modes, the territory bonus and the forced trade.

200.description: Rules returned. They never change at runtime, so clients may cache them.

get.summary:
Lists every territory's state in a game (blizzards included), optionally filtered by owner.
Empty until the game has started. Continents and neighbours come from `GET /api/map`.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Optional: filter to territories owned by this player ID.

put.summary: Deploys troops from the authenticated player's reserve to their territory.

attackingTroopsCount.description: How many dice the attacker rolls: 1–3, leaving one troop behind.

defendingTroopsCount.description: Ignored: the server always rolls as many dice as the defender may. Will be removed.

movingTroopsCount.description: Troops to move in if the territory is conquered; null leaves the conquest pending.
